rag.search.source: own: about twice the measured p95 on the seeded audit corpus; no published threshold for an internal search API

rag.status.link.source: own: the chip polls it every second, so it must stay well under the 1 s poll interval; 200 ms leaves room for two outbound probes

rag.status.summary.source: own: baseline plus a margin for a larger index (it scans every chunk today)

mcp.tools_list.source: own: the p95 is the first call's remote sid validation; later calls are cached

answer.time_to_first_token.repo: all (Frappe relay, agent, model, MCP, rag)
answer.time_to_first_token.source: own, bounded by Nielsen's 10 s limit for keeping attention (https://www.nngroup.com/articles/response-times-3-important-limits/); the model on this host is gemma4:26b

answer.total.source: own, same bound; a short grounded answer

metis.lab.source: published: Core Web Vitals 'good' thresholds LCP 2.5 s and CLS 0.1 (https://web.dev/articles/vitals), Lighthouse TBT 200 ms; lab run with Lighthouse 12 mobile defaults

metis.bundle_js_gzip_kb.source: own: baseline plus 10 per cent so the bundle cannot grow unnoticed
